translations.web: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save, as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.
translations.bsb: On the first day of every week, each of you should set aside a portion of his income, saving it up, so that when I come no collections will be needed.
translations.kjv: Upon the first day of the week let ➔ every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that ➔ there be no gatherings when I come.
translations.asv: Upon the first day of the week let each one of you lay by him in store, as he may prosper, that no collections be made when I come.
